title: Vee CI command
description: The result of `vee ci command`: the command a pull request comment held, what Vee did, and the review it ran, if any.

command.description: The command, or null when the comment held none or could not be read.

outcome.description: ignored: no command, or written by a bot. invalid: the command could not be read. refused: the author, the pull request or the finding did not allow it. done: Vee carried it out.

reply_id.description: The host's ID of Vee's reply.
